question: Should OpenClaw core permanently reserve the top-level `auth` CLI namespace even when installed plugins already advertise that root?
rationale: Current bootstrap gives built-in roots precedence and suppresses plugin registration, so accepting this alias establishes a compatibility policy rather than only adding syntax sugar.

options.title: Keep plugin ownership
options.body: Do not add a core `auth` root; retain `openclaw models auth list` or choose a non-conflicting alias.

options.title: Reserve core auth
options.body: Approve `auth` as a core namespace and require a documented migration and compatibility path for plugins already using it.

recommendation.title: Keep plugin ownership
recommendation.body: Do not add a core `auth` root; retain `openclaw models auth list` or choose a non-conflicting alias.
